about.focusBody:
I focus my work on building secure, reproducible and well-documented solutions, prioritizing robustness, traceability and operational efficiency. I combine a defensive mindset with automation and analysis capabilities, which allows me to address complex problems from a structured, results-oriented perspective.

I work from Madrid in a hybrid model, with availability to collaborate in distributed environments and remote projects.
